title: Compose functions
hints: Define an inner function inside compose that takes x, and return that inner function (without calling it).
The inner function loops over the functions and re-assigns x = f(x) each time; use reversed(funcs) so the last one given runs first.
Check callable(f) for every f in a loop before defining the inner function, raising TypeError; with no functions the loop body never runs and x comes back unchanged.
